# goslop text fixture — generic except re-raises domain error (html2pic FP)
lang: python
file: CWE-396-batch3-reraise-from-safe.py
---
class RenderError(Exception):
    pass

def render(tree):
    try:
        return translate(tree)
    except Exception as e:
        raise RenderError(f"Failed to render: {e}") from e
